name: Plan, build, verify
description: Plan, wait for approval, build, run the plan's criteria checks, verify the other criteria in a fresh context and send the findings back to the builder until it passes, then review the diff and send the findings back to the builder — which applies what it agrees with, including the minor nits it finds worth taking — verified again, for up to two rounds per outcome; findings left after that go to the human.
